prompt: Write clamp.py: clamp(value, lo, hi) returns value limited to the inclusive range lo..hi, unchanged when already inside it.

setup.test_clamp.py:
from clamp import clamp


def test_clamp_lowers():
    assert clamp(5, 0, 3) == 3
    assert clamp(-5, 0, 3) == 0


def test_clamp_passes_through():
    assert clamp(2, 0, 3) == 2
    assert clamp(7, 0, 10) == 7
